title: Arriving in New Orleans and the shock of the modern city
summary: The interviewer changes subject to Bull's week in New Orleans; Bull finds the city more modern than his imagined French village, and hears Jim Robinson's band at Preservation Hall.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings
